description: §19.10.4 (S450 interim, fail-closed) — a `return`, or a `break` / `continue` whose target is outside the block, inside a `transaction { }` in a function is E-TRANSACTION-CONTROL-FLOW. §19.10.3 decides only completion (COMMIT), `fail` and a SQL error (ROLLBACK); whether another exit commits or rolls back is undecided, so the compiler rejects it rather than guess. Two sites → exactly two diagnostics.
rationale: §19.10.4: "The compiler SHALL guarantee that every `transaction` block either commits (on success) or rolls back (on `fail` or SQL error). No transaction SHALL be left open." The commit-or-rollback choice for `return` / `break` / `continue` out of the block has no governing sentence (searched §19.10, §8.9); the S450 interim sentence in §19.10.4 rejects it pending a ruling.
